positions.title: Computational Biology Research Assistant
positions.description: Completed, tested, and expanded a Python program allowing users to visualize solutions outputted by the optimization algorithm; expanded and optimized an algorithm to work for non-binary gene trees

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern (Front End)
positions.description:
-	Developed integrated map component for existing React web app to improve user experience for an internal operational tool that manages software deploys and monitoring for a fleet of vehicles
-	Created feature architecture proposal, by working closely with product manager and designer 
-	Collected and addressed feedback from fellow teammates to refine design and implementation details
-	Explored and implemented new software, RxJS, GraphQL, Deck.gl (map visualization) to facilitate real time updates on map

positions.title: Grader for Online Python Courses
positions.description: Provided comprehensive feedback and guidance to participants on homework and projects

positions.title: Front End Intern
positions.description: Worked in a three-person team to use ReactJS, HTML, and CSS to implement preliminary designs for the desktop and mobile websites after learning JavaScript and ReactJS with limited supervision in the first few weeks

positions.title: Machine Learning Summer Course Instructor
positions.description: Developed and expanded upon various machine learning programs with the purpose of guiding students during a summer camp

positions.title: Summer Engineering Intern
positions.description: Learned engineering concepts and techniques with the College of Engineering; worked on numerous small projects with other participants including designing and building a bridge, designing and building a windmill, designing and 3D printing a derby car
